![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The call to `mkRunLog(root, paths)` on line 886 is completely redundant because its return value is ignored, and the source manifest is read and parsed again on the very next line using `readJsonInput`. This causes duplicate file reads and JSON parsing.

Please remove the redundant `mkRunLog` call to optimize efficiency.

```suggestion
  const inputDiagnostics = [];
  const sourceManifest = readJsonInput(root, paths.sourceManifest, 'semantic_kg_source_manifest', inputDiagnostics);
```
